payload.objective: Keep the Rows safe. Decide whether silence can stand.
journal: A voice bearing Edda’s private knot came from the sealed descent route.
Crew code — Split Bough → Lantern → Open Ring.
The Hanging Rows have one night of stored light. The station cell could power them for a season.
The fresh signal came from below service depth and carries Edda Vale’s identity knot.
A Voice Traded for Light — The Rows are safe for a season. Edda’s fresh signal ended before its warning was complete.
